metadata.description: Three user-assigned managed identities whose names use ONLY parameters/variables/concat/uniqueString (no resourceGroup). The prefix uniquestring1/2/3 marks which declaration built each one. Covers single-, two-, and three-argument uniqueString.
Default uses uniqueString with TWO arguments. Resource 2's name is [parameters('nameFromParam')].

resources.comments: Resource 1 — name built DIRECTLY: concat + uniqueString (single argument)
resources.name: [concat('uniquestring1-', uniqueString('ohadca-one'))]

resources.comments: Resource 2 — name via PARAMETER whose default uses uniqueString with two arguments
resources.name: [parameters('nameFromParam')]

resources.comments: Resource 3 — name via VARIABLE using uniqueString with three arguments
resources.name: [variables('nameFromVar')]
